facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's HMIS Eswatini account says healthcare workers at Nhlangano Health Facility were given iPads for real-time patient data capture at the point of care in the CMIS Inpatient and Maternity Module, which was to go live there on 9 November 2026.

HMIS Eswatini reports the CMIS Inpatient and Maternity Module rollout moved to end-user training after a training of trainers, with Nhlangano as the first site of this scale-up phase and training to continue in other regions.
The rollout is announced by HMIS Eswatini, described as the Ministry of Health's HMIS unit.
